title: Empty-oracle step agreement
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, and let $c$ be a configuration with $k+1$ work tapes. The successor of $c$ under the plain machine obtained from $M$ by the empty-oracle elimination is equal to the successor of $c$ under $M$ with the empty oracle.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes
replaced:
Let $M$ be an oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes and let $c$ be a
configuration with $k+1$ work tapes.  One step of the plain machine obtained
from $M$ by the empty-oracle elimination, taken from $c$, equals one step of
$M$ relative to the empty oracle, taken from $c$.
